# PredictPro — AI Football Predictions

> PredictPro (https://predictpro.guru) is an AI-powered football prediction and quantitative sports analytics platform providing daily match predictions, Expected Goals (xG) models, bivariate Poisson scorelines, +EV value bets, 17-game jackpot picks, live scores, and league standings across 40+ global competitions.

PredictPro combines historical head-to-head (H2H) records, rolling 10-match Expected Goals (xG and xGA), Dixon-Coles home advantage adjustments, and real-time bookmaker odds movement to generate daily confidence-scored football predictions.

## Core Prediction Markets

- [Today's AI Football Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/): Daily AI match predictions, confidence scores, and live fixtures across 40+ global leagues.
- [Best Banker Bets Today](https://predictpro.guru/best-bets): High-confidence (75%+ to 92%) 1X2 straight win and Double Chance banker selections.
- [Daily Value Bets (+EV)](https://predictpro.guru/value-bets): Positive Expected Value wagers where AI Poisson probability exceeds bookmaker implied odds.
- [BTTS & Over 2.5 Goals Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/btts): Both Teams to Score and Over/Under 2.5 goal expectancy tips.
- [Exact Correct Score Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/correct-score): Bivariate Poisson 90-minute scoreline probability matrices.
- [Smart Accumulator Builder](https://predictpro.guru/accumulator): Low-correlation 3-fold and 5-fold multibet slip generator.
- [Dropping Odds & Sharp Steam Radar](https://predictpro.guru/dropping-odds): Real-time bookmaker odds compression and Closing Line Value (CLV) tracker.

## League Prediction Hubs

- [English Premier League Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/premier-league-predictions): AI match previews, xG stats, and odds for every EPL fixture.
- [UEFA Champions League Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/champions-league-predictions): 36-team league phase and knockout tie AI predictions.
- [Spanish La Liga Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/la-liga-predictions): Tactical match forecasts and value picks for La Liga.
- [German Bundesliga Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/bundesliga-predictions): High-tempo Over 2.5 goals, BTTS, and 1X2 Bundesliga tips.
- [Italian Serie A Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/serie-a-predictions): Defensive xGA and match outcome forecasts for Serie A.
- [FKF Kenya Premier League Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/kpl-predictions): Kenyan Premier League, Tanzania NBC League, and East African match predictions.
- [AFCON, CAF & Pan-African Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/afcon-predictions): Full continental coverage across all 54 CAF nations including AFCON, CAF Champions League, Nigeria NPFL, South Africa PSL, DR Congo Linafoot, Egyptian Premier League, and Morocco Botola Pro.
- [17-Game Mega Jackpot Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/jackpot-predictions): SportPesa Mega Jackpot, Betika Grand Jackpot, and Mozzart Super Grand Jackpot banker and Double Chance combinations.
- [FIFA World Cup 2026 Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/world-cup-predictions): World Cup qualifiers and tournament knockout simulations.
- [US Soccer & MLS Predictions](https://predictpro.guru/us-soccer-predictions): Major League Soccer moneyline (+/-), goal spreads, and AI picks.

## Interactive Analytics & Strategy Guides

- [Universal Bookmaker Booking Code Converter](https://predictpro.guru/slip-generator): Translate accumulator booking codes across SportyBet, 1xBet, Bet9ja, Betway, SportPesa, and Betika with 2× High-DPI PNG slip export.
- [6×6 Bivariate Poisson & Dixon-Coles Score Matrix](https://predictpro.guru/poisson-calculator): Interactive 36-cell exact scoreline probability matrix and fair odds simulator.
- [Club Expected Goals (xG) & FDR Analytics Hub](https://predictpro.guru/teams): Club-specific rolling xG, defensive xGA, and 5-match Fixture Difficulty Ratings (`/teams/arsenal`, `/teams/real-madrid`, `/teams/manchester-city`, etc.).
- [Interactive AI Match Predictor](https://predictpro.guru/predict): Custom club-vs-club Poisson and xG match simulator.
- [Head-to-Head (H2H) Team Comparison](https://predictpro.guru/h2h): Side-by-side statistical comparison and historical H2H records.
- [Team Winning Streaks Radar](https://predictpro.guru/streaks): Consecutive wins, unbeaten runs, and Over 2.5 / BTTS team streaks.
- [Live Football Scores & In-Play Odds](https://predictpro.guru/live): Real-time match trackers, live scores, and in-play momentum.
- [League Standings & Form Tables](https://predictpro.guru/standings): Current league tables, points, and Expected Points (xPTS) Justice Tables.
- [Quantitative Methodology](https://predictpro.guru/methodology): Documentation of PredictPro's bivariate Poisson, Dixon-Coles, xG, and ensemble AI architecture.
- [Football Strategy & Quantitative Blog](https://predictpro.guru/blog): 20+ educational guides on Universal Booking Code Conversion, 6×6 Poisson Matrices, 2-Score Dutching, Referee Prop Modeling, and Kelly Criterion bankroll management.
- [HTML Sitemap & Google Discover Directory](https://predictpro.guru/sitemap): Complete index of 185+ canonical pages, leagues, club xG hubs, tools, and match predictions.

## Machine-Readable Sitemaps, Feeds & Social Card API

- [Master Sitemap Index](https://predictpro.guru/sitemap-index.xml): Partitioned XML sitemaps (`/sitemap.xml`, `/sitemap-core.xml`, `/sitemap-leagues.xml`, `/sitemap-matches.xml`, `/sitemap-blog.xml`, `/sitemap-yandex.xml`).
- [Primary XML Sitemap](https://predictpro.guru/sitemap.xml): Unified canonical sitemap with `<image:image>` Google Discover tags and 54 regional hreflang annotations.
- [RSS 2.0 & Atom 1.0 Syndication Feeds](https://predictpro.guru/rss.xml): Also available at `/feed.xml` (Atom 1.0) and `/feed-predictions.xml` (Daily Match Predictions RSS).
- [Dynamic 1200×630 OpenGraph Card Generator](https://predictpro.guru/api/og): Edge-rendered SVG social cards for matches and multibet slips (`max-image-preview:large`).
